command:
$app = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner-app"
$android = Join-Path $app "android"
"=== commit wrapper ==="
git -C $app add android/gradlew.bat android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties 2>&1 | Out-Null
git -C $app add -f android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar 2>&1 | Out-Null
git -C $app -c user.name="pc-runner" -c user.email="pc-runner@local" commit -m "Add Gradle wrapper (manual)" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
git -C $app pull --rebase 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
git -C $app push 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
"=== build with wrapper ==="
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools\jdk-21"
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME
& (Join-Path $android "gradlew.bat") -p $android assembleDebug 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 25
